contract: The legacy pipeline entry point remains python main.py.
The weekly GitHub Action still runs python main.py and is not modified in phase 1.
The ai_signal package runs in shadow mode and does not take over collection, LLM calls, packaging, publishing or email delivery.
main.py, requirements.txt and the weekly workflow are explicitly out of scope and must not be edited.
The local SQLite store is the future source of truth but is not yet wired into production.
